verdict.rationale: Daytona is sandbox infrastructure for running AI-generated code. It is not an agent or AI app that consumes tools, so acting as an MCP client is outside its product role. The evidence shows only that Daytona provides its own MCP server for agents such as Claude, Cursor and Windsurf to use. That is the server role and does not transfer to this client-side story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
